source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the rare-color template onto every all-zero occurrence."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The rare color is the marked template; the two common colors form noise.
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells]
    sh = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in range(h - sh + 1):
        for c0 in range(w - sw + 1):
            points = [(r0 + dr, c0 + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in points):
                for r, c in points:
                    out[r][c] = marker
    return out
'''
